title: 用勾股定理求正方形中的线段长
stem:
如图，正方形ABCD的顶点A，B分别在x轴，y轴上，A（﹣4，0），G（0，4），BC的中点E恰好落在x轴上，CD交y轴于点F，连接DG，DO．给出判断：①BF＝AE；②CD平分∠ODG；③∠AEB+∠CDG＝90°； ④△ADO是等腰三角形．其中正确的是（　　）
〔图1〕
given_solution:
【分析】根据正方形的性质，可得\(\vartriangle ABE≌\vartriangle BCF\)，从而得到①③正确，延长GD，过A作GD延长线的垂线并与GD的延长线交于点H，再由A，G的坐标，可推出\(\vartriangle ADH≌\vartriangle ABO\)，得出D是HG的中点，最后得出△ADO是等腰三角形进而判断④，先假设CD平分∠ODG，根据已知条件得到\(AO=OD\)，根据点的坐标求得\(AO\ne OD\)进而可以判断②．
【详解】\(\because\)\(ABCD\)是正方形，
\(\therefore\)\(\angle ABC=\angle BCD=90{}^\circ\)
又\(\angle ABO+\angle EBO=\angle ABO+\angle BAO\) \(=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle EBO=\angle BAO\),
在\(\vartriangle ABE\)和\(\vartriangle BCF\)中，
\(\begin{cases} \angle EBO=\angle BAO \\ \angle BCF=\angle ABE=90{}^\circ \\ BC=AB \end{cases}\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle ABE≌\vartriangle BCF\left ( { { \rm{ A } }{ \rm{ A } }{ \rm{ S } } } \right )\)
\(\therefore BF=AE\)故①正确；
\(\because \angle DFG=\angle CFB,\angle DGF=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle CDG=\angle CBF\)又\(\angle AEB+\angle CBF=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle AEB+\angle CDG=90{}^\circ\)
故③正确；
延长\(GD\)，过\(A\)作\(GD\)延长线的垂线并与\(GD\)的长线交于点\(H\)，则\(HA\bot AO\)
〔图2〕
\(\because AH=OG=4\)
\(\therefore AH=AO\)
\(\begin{cases} AD=AB \\ AH=AO \end{cases}\)
\(\therefore Rt\vartriangle ADH≌Rt\vartriangle ABO\left ( { { \rm{ H } }{ \rm{ L } } } \right )\)
\(\therefore DH=OB\)
\(\because\)\(\vartriangle ABE≌\vartriangle BCF\)
\(\therefore BE=CF\)
\(\because\)\(E\)是\(BC\)的中点
\(\therefore BE=\frac { 1 } { 2 }BC=\frac { 1 } { 2 }DC\)
\(\therefore CF=DF=\frac { 1 } { 2 }DC\)
\(\therefore BE=DF\)
\(\because \angle DFG+\angle GDF=90{}^\circ\)，
由①可知\(\angle AEB+\angle CDG=90{}^\circ\)
\(\because \angle CFB=\angle DFG\)
\(\therefore \angle DFG=\angle BEO\)
\(\because \angle DGF=\angle OEB=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle DFG≌\vartriangle BEO\)
\(\therefore DG=OB\)
\(\therefore BE=\frac { 1 } { 2 }BC=\frac { 1 } { 2 }CD=CF=FD\)
\(\therefore AH=AO\)
\(\therefore\) 四边形\(AHGO\) 是正方形
\(\therefore HG=4\)
\(\therefore DH=OB=2\)
\(\therefore DG=2\)
\(\therefore DH=DG\)
\(\therefore D(-2,4)\)
\(\because HA=OG,\angle H=\angle DGO\)
\(\therefore Rt\vartriangle AHD≌Rt\vartriangle OGD\)
\(\therefore\)\(AD=DO\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle ADO\)是等腰三角形，
故④正确：
若CD平分∠ODG
则\(\angle CDG=\angle CDO\)
\(\because\)\(\angle AEB+\angle CDG=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle AEB+\angle CDO=90{}^\circ\)
\(\because \angle EAB+\angle AEB=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle CDO=\angle EAB\)
\(\because \angle CDO+\angle OAD=90{}^\circ ,\angle EAB+\angle DAO=90{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore OA=OD\)
\(\because A(-4,0),D(-2,4)\)
\(\therefore OA=4,OD=\sqrt[] { 2 ^ { 2 } +4 ^ { 2 } }=2\sqrt[] { 5 }\)
\(\therefore OA\ne OD\)
故②不正确
综上所述，①③④正确．
故选D．
